author.description: Author name extracted from the article (may be empty, full name, or initials)

editor.description: Editor/director name extracted from footer (may be empty)

media_group.description: Media group/publisher name extracted from footer (may be empty)

signature_type.description: One of: FULL_NAME | INITIALS | NONE. FULL_NAME = proper name with first and last name. INITIALS = capital letters only (2-4 chars). NONE = empty or no identifiable author.

has_editor.description: True if editor/director name is present and valid

has_media_group.description: True if media group/publisher name is present and valid

explanation.description: Brief explanation of what was found (e.g., 'Full name author + editor + media group')
